name: 侠客梦
english_description: Shares a code lineage (the same set of simul_efuns) with this project's jym (Jin Yong's Dream), though its registration flow branches differently, so the two should not be assumed to share an identical connection sequence. It also shares the same "Xiake Xing I" map skeleton (Taihu Ancient Tomb, Kunlun, Shaolin, and more) with xkx2000zxb, making all three different circulating versions drawn from the same underlying codebase.
